claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the mitt for applying self tanner evenly and without streaks.
Many reviewers highlight the thumb slot and soft, well-made material as standout features.
Several reviewers say the mitt prevents tanner from staining their hands.
A few reviewers note the mitt absorbs or holds a lot of product, which can be wasteful or lighten results.
Some reviewers mention initial skepticism about quality or price that was overcome after use.

qa.q: Does it leave streaks or apply evenly?
qa.answer: Reviews report the mitt applies product evenly without streaks [1][4][6], with one noting dampening it gives streakless coverage [2]. However, one reviewer noted product seeped through onto their hands and caused patchy buildup there [3].

claims.text: The mitt helped apply an even amount of lotion with no streaking [1].
The mitt rubs product evenly and leaves no streaks or imperfections [4].
It gives a smooth, natural and even tan [6].
Dampening the mitt helps product glide on for streakless coverage [2].
Product seeped through onto the hands and left patchy buildup on the hands [3].

qa.q: How well does it hold up after washing?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it comfortable to wear on your hand?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on comfort: some find it comfortable and non-slipping [1][2][4], while others say it slides around on the hand [3][5].

claims.text: It has a comfortable design and doesn't slip off the hand.
The thumb helps keep the hand in place and it doesn't slip off.

qa.q: Does it prevent orange palms and stains?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to other mitts?
qa.answer: Reviews say it is worth the price: one notes it delivers "what you pay for and more" and advises paying extra [1], and another calls it "worth every penny" for a smooth, even tan [3]. However, one reviewer felt the product seemed cheap and light compared to their old mitt on arrival, though they still preferred it after use [2].
